about_the_game:
Adds a new dialogue hub with Hollywood, last of the Ulthar Kittens.

Also gives access to the Soundtrack, located outside of the main folder.

The tracks are as follows:

1. End's Nigh
2. Fun Itself
3. Aquatic Vigil
4. Strange Eons
5. Band Practice
6. Night Gaunt Waltz
